description: This file defines traits related to RPC endpoints in Apache Spark, including RpcEndpoint, RpcEnvFactory, and traits for thread safety and isolation of RPC endpoints.

classes.name: RpcEnvFactory
classes.description: A trait for factories that create RpcEnv instances, requiring an empty constructor for reflection.

classes.name: RpcEndpoint
classes.description: An endpoint trait for handling RPC messages, with lifecycle methods and message processing functions.

classes.name: ThreadSafeRpcEndpoint
classes.description: A trait indicating that an RpcEndpoint is thread-safe.

classes.name: IsolatedRpcEndpoint
classes.description: An endpoint trait that uses a dedicated thread pool for message delivery.

classes.name: IsolatedThreadSafeRpcEndpoint
classes.description: An endpoint that uses a dedicated thread pool and is thread-safe, with threadCount fixed at 1.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an RpcEnv instance given a configuration.

methods.name: self
methods.description: Returns the RpcEndpointRef of this endpoint, valid after onStart.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: PartialFunction to process incoming messages; throws SparkException if message is unmatched.

methods.name: receiveAndReply
methods.description: PartialFunction to process messages expecting replies; defaults to failure.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles exceptions thrown during message processing; default rethrows the cause.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Called when a remote address connects.

methods.name: onDisconnected
methods.description: Called when a remote address disconnects.

methods.name: onNetworkError
methods.description: Called on network errors between nodes.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Called before the endpoint starts handling messages.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Called when the endpoint is stopping.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Convenient method to stop the RpcEndpoint via rpcEnv.

methods.name: threadCount
methods.description: Defines number of threads for delivering messages in IsolatedRpcEndpoint; fixed at 1 in IsolatedThreadSafeRpcEndpoint.
